summary: The joint Phase 2 JUnit records four passing browser cases: authenticated dashboard, dashboard links, no-404 main links, and priority dashboard sidebar links. Navigation cases are grouped with the dashboard checks in one pytest process and are reported jointly.
limitations: The isolated Phase 2 subset passed its selected tests without skips, but this is not a full RC or release sign-off.

Phase 2 server stderr still records 19 SystemAuditCompositionUnavailable mentions and 14 DataFetchError mentions for calendar-dependent paths; this remains an unresolved service limitation outside the selected passing cases.
The original RC3 full journey JUnit is retained as baseline failure evidence (not as candidate validation).

The Phase 2 joint JUnit uses the exact seven-overlay source manifest copied here; the older diagnostic patch review and formatter-equivalence proof are separate artifacts and do not, by themselves, establish that the reviewed patch is byte-identical to the Phase 2 test source.
Formatter evidence records AST equality between the frozen diagnostic candidate and its Black-formatted version; this is a static equivalence result, not an additional test run.

command_summaries.command: python -m black --check <Phase2 Python overlays>; python -m isort --check-only <same>; python -m ruff check <same>
